clubs.name: Island Club
clubs.blurb: Where everyone starts: a tiki stage, a trio, and the sea.

matches.title: First Serve
matches.tip: Play the note on the ball. If you need to look, the ball waits for you.

matches.title: The Pop-Up
matches.tip: Steady 3rds wear them down until they pop one up. Spike it with the 5th.

matches.title: Their Spike
matches.tip: A second chord, G. And now they spike: save it with the root.

matches.title: Minor Turn
matches.tip: Four chords, one of them minor. Listen for the change.

clubs.name: Riverside Juke
clubs.place: Down by the river at dusk
clubs.blurb: Twelve-bar blues and a shack band that swings.

matches.title: Seventh Heaven
matches.tip: One chord, C7: a chord with four notes. Pop-up? Dink it with the 7th.

matches.title: Slow Burn
matches.tip: Slow, and every ball is yours.

clubs.name: Rooftop Club
clubs.blurb: Jazz under string lights, and the pace picks up.

matches.title: ii–V–I
matches.tip: Pop-up? The 9th is the killer dink.

matches.title: Turnaround
matches.tip: New keys: F, B♭ and G.

matches.title: Jump Street
matches.tip: Fast, and every ball is yours.

matches.title: Minor Key
matches.tip: Minor chords: the 3rd is one fret lower.

matches.title: Bossa
matches.tip: m7♭5: a minor chord with its 5th a fret lower.

clubs.name: Grand Slam Stadium
clubs.blurb: The big show. Everything you’ve learned, in any key.

matches.title: The Final
matches.tip: First to 11. Win this, win the Tour.
